name: executive-laws-unlock-with-evidence
notes: Stdlib-only, no-app, no-network and no-port stop being eternal principles and become revisable executive laws, each carrying a version, owner, arbiter test and review path. An external dependency, HTTP API, local server or vector index is refused for absence of evidence, not for complexity. Unlocking one requires all six: a named problem, a measured baseline on the same dataset, a before and after win with repeat counts, a cost and risk review, a bounded blast radius with a stdlib fallback and the feature flag false until the evidence lands, and a decision record joining the five. The offline core, human approval before any listener, and the rule that private data never leaves are not unlockable by any benchmark.
